text: Buried anger is rarely dead anger. So what do we do with our anger? Suppressing it doesn't work; it's not helpful. And so some then perhaps thought, "Well, let me express anger. Let me just get it out." I grew up being told that if you want, don't suppress it; that's bad for you. You'll implode. And so express it. Maybe you had that advice. You know, be Mike Tyson against some pillows and just let it out. But actually, recent research says that the more we express our anger, we actually become more.
